title: PR 93's engine with Zarith numbers: three starts of its table to 10<sup>5363</sup> steps
text: Extracting the same Coq definitions with binary numbers realized by Zarith makes the accelerated engine of busycoq pull request 93 tens of times faster, with full compressed states equal to the old engine's at 3.5·10<sup>7</sup> and 2.9·10<sup>7</sup> fast steps. In an hour it ran 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB0LF, 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA0RF and 1RB0RF_0LC---_1LD1LC_1RE0LA_1RA1RD_0RD0RF about 3·10<sup>8</sup> fast steps each without a stop, on tapes of more than 2<sup>17800</sup> cells: no halt in the first 10<sup>5363</sup> steps. Their Coq halting proofs still wait for a stop.
